description: Djibouti - Aerodromes is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA). Other settlements were obtained from topographic maps of Djibouti that were scanned and geo-referenced. This layer shows airports in the country. Coverage: Djibouti. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA). Its tags are aviation, facilities-infrastructure, geodata, transportation. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
